name: Privacy-Aware Telemetry Redaction
description: Telemetry must not leak: file contents, user secrets, PII, session tokens. Redaction rules applied before export.
acceptanceCriteria: Redaction rules defined for file contents, secrets, PII, tokens
Redaction applied at export time (not collection time)
Redaction audit log tracks what was redacted
Integration tests verify no sensitive data in exported telemetry
